end.summary:
Observed and described a bird seen in the morning.
Identified a short beak and long tail; guessed it might eat seeds.
Practised using beak and feet shapes to infer how an animal feeds.
Later connected a long, pointed beak and webbed feet with catching fish.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Atharv practised observing birds closely and describing beaks, tails, and feet. They used visual clues and, later in the lesson, connected a long pointed beak and webbed feet with catching fish. They needed prompts to explain how features help an animal, but this connection was made later. At home, ask them to observe one bird or plant and name two features and what each feature may help it do.
